title: [GMCP 203.012.03] Integration: Subscriptions, notifications, progress, and operational messages
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-012-03. Wire the capability through every applicable server, client, host, gateway, SDK, CLI, configuration, callback, supervisor, persistence, and migration surface. Prove that direct, daemon, and gateway entry points share the same implementation and policy boundaries. Vector outcome: Modern subscriptions/listen filters and acknowledgement metadata work for tools, prompts, resources and resource updates, with bounded fan-out, ordering guarantees, cancellation, reconnect policy, backpressure and authorization re-checks. Progress and operational log notifications correlate to the originating request, obey requested levels and redaction, and never become an unbounded covert channel. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
